topics.title_zh: 五大巨头三年狂砸3万亿美元，奥特曼主张RAM必须收归数据中心
topics.title_en: Tech Giants Commit $3T AI CapEx as Altman Claims RAM Belongs in Data Centers
topics.summary_zh: 谷歌、Meta等巨头豪赌超3万亿美元算力开支致股东回报跌至15年冰点，英特尔暴跌28%。同时奥特曼高调声称全球RAM留在云端数据中心比留在个人电脑桌面上效率更高，引发本地端侧硬件阵营与垄断云端的全面对立。
topics.summary_en: Big Tech has committed over $3 trillion to AI infrastructure, driving shareholder payouts to a 15-year low and tanking Intel shares by 28%. Amid the frenzy, Sam Altman stirred fierce debate by asserting that RAM is more efficiently pooled in hyperscale data centers than sitting idle on local desks.

perspective_pro.point_zh: 超大模型推理与万亿参数训练需要极致内存池化与高带宽互联，集中部署在数据中心能最大化资源利用率并加速AGI迭代。
perspective_pro.point_en: Centralizing RAM and compute maximizes pooling efficiency and high-bandwidth utilization required for frontier models, preventing idle silicon waste.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 资本理性与端侧自治派
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 华尔街价值投资者与开源端侧开发者
perspective_con.speaker_en: Wall Street Analysts & Edge AI Builders
perspective_con.point_zh: 3万亿资本开支严重脱离现金流产出并压榨股东分红，鼓吹剥夺端侧RAM本质是云巨头为了维系高昂API订阅租金而制造的算力围墙。
perspective_con.point_en: Aggressive CapEx crushes free cash flow with questionable ROI. Forcing memory into the cloud is a rent-seeking maneuver to kill local, private AI alternatives.

topics.title_zh: 承包商将Claude Code接入五角大楼，Cursor插件市场遭遇投毒反噬
topics.title_en: Pentagon Infiltrated by Claude Agents as Cursor Plugin Poisoning Hits 5,000 Devs
topics.summary_zh: 国防承包商正将Claude智能体接驳至五角大楼国防安全系统，展现AI自主接入机密运维的激进态势；与此同时，Cursor扩展商店中伪装的Claude Code插件被恶意投毒导致5000名工程师面临窃密风险，暴露出自主代码Agent极易成为供应链后门。
topics.summary_en: Defense contractors have integrated Claude Code into secure Pentagon DoD networks, showcasing the aggressive military adoption of autonomous agents. Simultaneously, a malicious Claude Code extension poisoned Cursor's marketplace, compromising 5,000 developers and exposing the vulnerabilities of the agentic software ecosystem.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: Anthropic生态开发者与防务承包商
perspective_pro.point_zh: 智能体已具备闭环解决复杂系统工程的能力，将其深度嵌入核心国防与系统级IDE，能成百倍提升重构效率与高危漏洞排查速度。
perspective_pro.point_en: Agentic systems autonomously navigate complex legacy pipelines, dramatically cutting system migration times and securing tactical software readiness at scale.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 网络安全审计专家与逆向工程分析师
perspective_con.point_zh: 给具备自主执行权限的Agent盲目下放高权限等同于开门揖盗，从IDE插件投毒到机密系统越权，自主智能体正在成为最大不可控攻击面。
perspective_con.point_en: Granting unvetted execution rights to autonomous agents creates lethal supply-chain attack vectors, turning developer tools and sovereign defense stacks into exploitable targets.

topics.category_tag_zh: 太空数据中心与天基算力
topics.title_zh: 谷歌太空AI卫星Suncatcher成功点火TPU，在轨运行Gemma 4发回俳句
topics.title_en: Google Suncatcher Satellite Boots TPU in Orbit, Streaming Gemma 4 Responses to Earth
topics.summary_zh: 谷歌正式确认其首颗天基原型数据中心卫星Suncatcher在轨启动成功，星载TPU加速芯片顺利运行轻量级大模型Gemma 4并向地球传回AI生成的太空俳句。此举宣告超大规模计算正突破地面电力与散热瓶颈，向空间太阳能驱动的天基算力集群跨出历史性一步。
topics.summary_en: Google confirmed that its orbital prototype data center, Project Suncatcher, successfully fired up custom TPUs in space, executing the Gemma 4 open-weights model to transmit responses back to Earth. The milestone marks a major push to bypass terrestrial power and cooling bottlenecks via space-based solar compute.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 谷歌系统架构师与商业航天工程师
perspective_pro.point_zh: 利用近地轨道24小时无衰减太阳能与近真空辐射散热，天基AI集群彻底打破地面电网与水冷承载极限，是算力脱敏地缘政治的最佳解。
perspective_pro.point_en: Orbital AI bypasses terrestrial power grids and cooling limits using continuous solar energy, opening an unconstrained compute horizon for sovereign-free modeling.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 航天抗辐射专家与数据通信工程师
perspective_con.point_zh: 太空高能宇宙射线对先进制程TPU的软错误反转是致命威胁，加上极其昂贵的发射维护成本与窄带星地回传延迟，让太空数据中心沦为营销噱头。
perspective_con.point_en: Cosmic radiation threatens advanced silicon reliability, while astronomical launch costs and bottlenecked downlink latency make orbital data centers commercially unviable gimmicks.
